d: The Mavericks defeated the Jazz, 116-114 tonight in Utah. Cooper Flagg contributed a team-high 28 points to go with 4 assists 3 rebounds and 3 three pointers, with Kyrie Irving of the Mavericks adding an additional 16 points (6-13 FG, 4-8 3P) in the game. Svi Mykhailiuk finished with a team-high 39 points along with 10 three pointers for the Jazz in the losing effort. The Mavericks improve their record to 10-7 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 3-15 for the season.
